title: CTAB DNA Extraction for High Quality Molecular Weight DNA
author: Yaowu Yuan
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.3rsgm6e

steps.title: Grind tissue in liquid nitrogen
steps.instruction: Grind plant tissue in a mortar that has been cooled with liquid nitrogen until a fine powder is obtained.

steps.title: Add CTAB buffer and form paste
steps.instruction: Add 750 µL of CTAB DNA Extraction buffer to the ground tissue, wait until the mixture warms and becomes a green paste, then transfer the paste to an Eppendorf tube.

steps.title: Incubate CTAB mixture
steps.instruction: Incubate the CTAB/plant extract mixture at 55 °C for 15 minutes in a heat block, inverting the tube periodically to mix throughout the incubation.

steps.title: Extract with chloroform‑isoamyl
steps.instruction: Add 500 µL of Chloroform : Isoamyl Alcohol (24 : 1) in the fume hood and mix the solution by inverting the tube (do not vortex).

steps.title: Collect aqueous phase
steps.instruction: Transfer the upper aqueous phase (approximately 500 µL) to a new Eppendorf tube.

steps.title: Add RNase A
steps.instruction: Add RNase A to a final concentration of 10 µg/mL; use 5 µL of a 1 mg/mL RNase A stock for a 500 µL sample.

steps.title: RNase incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate the tube at 37 °C for 30 minutes (00:30:00).

steps.title: Precipitate DNA with ethanol
steps.instruction: Add 50 µL of 7.5 M ammonium acetate, then add 500 µL of ice‑cold 100 % ethanol, and invert the tube to mix.

steps.title: Cold precipitation
steps.instruction: Place the tube in a –20 °C freezer for 1 hour (or longer) to precipitate the DNA.

steps.title: Pellet DNA by centrifugation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the tube for 15 minutes (00:15:00) and note the DNA pellet at the bottom of the tube.

steps.title: Wash DNA pellet (first)
steps.instruction: Remove the supernatant, add 500 µL of ice‑cold 70 % ethanol, and centrifuge for 5 minutes (00:05:00).

steps.title: Wash DNA pellet (second)
steps.instruction: Remove the supernatant, add another 500 µL of ice‑cold 70 % ethanol, and centrifuge for 5 minutes (00:05:00).

steps.title: Dry and resuspend DNA
steps.instruction: Remove all remaining supernatant, allow the pellet to air‑dry in the hood for approximately 20 minutes (00:20:00) without overdrying, then resuspend the DNA in 50 µL of dH₂O.

steps.title: Quantify DNA
steps.instruction: Measure DNA concentration with a NanoDrop spectrophotometer, or alternatively run a 0.4 % agarose gel overnight with a lambda DNA mono‑cut ladder to estimate concentration and size.
